title: Unprecedented 'fire clouds' are fanning the flames in France | New Scientist
description: Flame-generated thunderstorms known as pyrocumulonimbus clouds can make wildfires even more intense, and they are expected to become more common in Europe
author: Alec Luhn

title: Mystery hominin left big footprints at ancient lake in Africa | New Scientist
description: Over 1.4 million years ago, a group of eight ancient hominins walked across a shallow mudflat, but their footprints don’t match those of Paranthropus boisei or Homo erectus
author: James Woodford

title: We’ve found the best example yet of an enormous wandering black hole | New Scientist
description: Astronomers have caught a supermassive black hole straying far from the centre of its galaxy using light from a star being ripped apart
author: Leah Crane

title: Eye implant that restores vision lost to age approved for use | New Scientist
description: An eye implant and a pair of high-tech glasses that enable people with a severe form of vision loss to read have been approved for use by a European regulator
author: Oluoma Aneke

title: One of NASA’s crucial links to deep space is at risk of burning down | New Scientist
description: The Deep Space Network is our best way to communicate with spacecraft beyond Earth’s orbit, and one of its three stations around the world is in the middle of a wildfire
author: Leah Crane

title: Clothes made from living fungi can clean and repair themselves | New Scientist
description: Researchers have created a textile made from the parasitic fungus Cordyceps militaris, which is biodegradable and can be adapted for different purposes with various microbes
author: James Woodford
